Projects.title: Profil Web Desa Keseneng
desc: A full-stack village profile and public information website for Desa Keseneng at desakeseneng.id, built as part of the KKN-PPM UGM community service program to give the village a professional digital presence.

The site is structured as a public-facing profile so visitors can quickly understand the village location, administrative data, local potential, and community activities without searching through scattered posts or informal channels.

Desa Keseneng is located in Kecamatan Mojotengah, Kabupaten Wonosobo, Jawa Tengah, with agriculture and local arts as its main strengths. Content planning reflects this real character, covering natural landscape, agro tourism, local MSMEs, and traditional arts and culture.

The information architecture separates village content into clear sections: village profile, population statistics, local potential (nature, agro tourism, MSMEs, arts and culture), news and activity updates, gallery, transparency, and public documents.

A key feature is a real-time environmental monitoring dashboard that ingests wind speed, humidity, and temperature data via MQTT, displayed as part of a disaster-preparedness (siaga bencana) page so residents can track local conditions directly from the website.

The project also includes a custom admin panel built for non-technical village staff, allowing them to independently manage news, announcements, agenda, gallery, and public transparency documents without developer involvement.

For the portfolio implementation, this project highlights full end-to-end web development: designing the database and content structure, building a responsive public-facing frontend, developing an internal admin panel, and integrating live sensor data through MQTT for a disaster-monitoring use case.

This project is a strong example of community-oriented, full-stack web development: the value lies not only in visual presentation, but in combining public information architecture, content management tooling, and real-time IoT data to support village administration, transparency, and public safety.

Projects.title: TokoManagement
desc: A store management web app that centralizes inventory, supplier, customer, and order workflows so owners can track daily operations without juggling spreadsheets.
Built with Laravel and Vue for fast CRUD and responsive UI, backed by MySQL and Dockerized pipelines on GitLab CI/CD to keep deployments reliable.

Projects.title: WHAStore
desc: WHAStore is a web e-commerce platform with a Go backend and Next.js frontend, using Zod to keep catalog, cart, and checkout flows consistently validated.
Midtrans powers payments, while PostgreSQL and Redis handle persistence and caching. Everything is Dockerized with GitLab CI/CD so releases stay fast and repeatable.

Projects.title: Avocycle
desc: A farmer-facing web app to manage avocado production - from tracking growers and plots to logging harvests and coordinating supply with buyers.
Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Axios for a responsive dashboard that keeps farmer data, inventory, and order status clear and actionable.

Projects.title: Predict Goal
desc: A Python-based project that trains Random Forest and KNN models on two Premier League seasons to predict total match goals.
Backend runs on Flask and is deployed to Railway, while Streamlit with HTML/CSS fronts the prediction UI so users can test scenarios directly in the browser.

Projects.title: Sarponesia
desc: A company profile site for a coffee producer, showcasing the business story, product lineup, and pricing to support promotion and customer inquiries.
Built with Laravel and MySQL to keep content manageable and product data structured.

Projects.title: SIMKLINIK UI/UX
desc: Designed the UI/UX for a veterinary clinic management system, focusing on clear flows for appointments, patient records, and billing.
Prototyped in Figma to keep handoff smooth for frontend implementation.
